name: Framework Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and the Establishment of a Foundation for Trustworthiness
description: Korea's first comprehensive AI statute. Establishes a risk-based framework (with a 'high-impact AI' category), mandatory generative and interactive AI transparency obligations (Article 31), safety duties for high-compute AI systems (Article 32), and a national AI policy and governance structure.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Ministry of Science and ICT (msit.go.kr) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Ministry of Science and ICT (msit.go.kr).
